## What's new
- **Idle model unload.** A loaded model is now freed after it sits unused for a configurable time (`runtime.idle_model_unload_seconds`, 60 seconds by default; set 0 to keep it loaded). The change applies without a restart, and a request that arrives while the model is being freed is still served. - **A clearer Observatory Overview.** A live status band shows what is running, which model, progress in the work's own units, and when the loaded model will be freed. Memory sits beside the loaded model, and session tiles show requests, speed, prompt reuse and SSD prompt cache use. - **Simpler Observatory navigation.** Model is part of Overview, Settings is part of Configuration, navigation moves to a top bar, and type and buttons are larger and easier to read. Old addresses open the pages that replaced them. - **Download Models.** The Library is now called Download Models everywhere. Model cards are easier to read, Cyber Tiel Coder is available as an experimental model, and Qwen 3.5 0.8B and 2B are marked as retiring soon.
## Fixes
- The menu bar popover no longer leaves an empty gap between the Flight and Progress rows; the progress bar now sits inside the Progress row. - Dense models no longer describe experts they do not have. - Thin Talk's image-model selector no longer flickers when one image model is installed. - Residency and Maximum model RAM each fit on one line in the menu bar popover.
## Compatibility
Existing settings and downloaded models carry over unchanged; no configuration settings were removed. Requires macOS 14 or later on Apple silicon.
This release is signed with a Developer ID certificate and notarized by Apple.
